title: The 5 biggest mistakes beginner programmers make with AI tools

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know 70% of new coders get burned by AI tools?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: AI isn’t magic — it needs clear instructions and context.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The biggest mistake? Treating AI like a copy-paste shortcut.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Most tools require specific prompts, like “generate code in Python.”

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Beginners waste hours debugging AI-generated errors.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Remember: AI is a helper, not a replacement for learning.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What’s your biggest AI coding mistake? Drop it below!
